code_change_audit.snapshot_binding: claims[].source_tar and build_manifest bind each source snapshot; Git head alone is not treated as exact build provenance
code_change_audit.verified: Mode 7 tracks/references/unique curves, time/value streams, predicted f32 tangent residuals, sorted values, reachable-key trimming and fragment reorder are implemented. tl7 uses the early codec; cg2 compacts decoder; m8 includes trim/order/renaming. Full exactness refers to the captured fixed timeline, not arbitrary input blobs or every possible time.
code_change_audit.risk: Unchecked fixed-data pointer decoding, finite capacities and SSE/MXCSR-sensitive prediction require immutable valid inputs and pinned evaluation conditions. Trimming self-checks are sampled; full native captures are the actual media evidence.

code_change_audit.verified: m8 source archive contains generated matching engine GL names; m11 has a smaller dead-local shader blob. Full packed captures, not only glslang/link checks, pass both hashes.
code_change_audit.risk: Regex/heuristic transformation is not a general GLSL equivalence proof; acceptance scope is these immutable programs on the recorded environment.

code_change_audit.verified: PATCH streams preserve the first 33 pinned records and BFS-relayout remaining graph references/constants; SCORE planes are transposed and restored. m8 snapshot includes both generated codecs. Entire 159716352-byte native PCM directly compares equal in every saved full run.
code_change_audit.risk: Generator invariants and unchecked decoders assume this fixed song/graph; not a claim of arbitrary-format decoder safety.

code_change_audit.verified: Custom i686 target sets frame-pointer=may-omit and function-sections=false; asm capture marker preserved. Build driver archives sources, stages/remaps paths, uses immediate-abort/nehalem/no-jump-tables, removes export/unused unwind bytes before real kkrunchy and publishes delivered EXE size. m23 adds fixed-core and inline-threshold=20. Packer-attribution tools exist; marginal estimates are not added together as shipped size.
code_change_audit.risk: No clean rebuild or compiler/packer execution was authorized in T31. Snapshot and existing decoded-media identity are verified, but newest clean-build/byte-identical repack reproducibility remains unproven here.

code_change_audit.verified: Already implemented after m8: sizecoded loader loops over one NUL-separated GL name string; bank uses FNV1a32. m8 input PE still imports bcrypt.dll; independently parsed m11/m23/tuned-m23 input import directories do not. m11 remains 50688 B despite distinct code/hash.

code_change_audit.verified: Runtime now checks exact length and FNV1a32; full SHA256 remains recorded as a constant/manifest identity, not an equivalent runtime check.
code_change_audit.risk: FNV1a32 is collision-prone/noncryptographic and strictly weaker at rejecting substituted banks. Decoder uses unsafe unchecked scanning justified by the identity pin, so collisions are a robustness/safety concern. Matching the accepted bank and exact PCM do not prove rejection of all altered banks.

code_change_audit.verified: Both executable hashes recomputed; applying declared model parameters to pinned model_asm.asm and depacker.asm reproduces both variant source files exactly. Same input PE/source as m23, different packer and shipped hash; saved full-GPU capture of actual tuned binary passes.
code_change_audit.limitation: Claim that rebuilding base model parameters reproduces pinned packer byte-for-byte was not independently rebuilt in this offline audit.
